name: Musk
body:
The character naturally produces a musk that makes him seem more charismatic to others.

Prerequisite(s): 4th-level Druid

Benefit: Once per day the character can produce a faint musk that adds a +2 racial bonus to all of her Charisma based skills for 10 minutes. The bonus does not apply if his is interacting with a construct, elemental, ooze, plant, undead, or vermin.
